text:
Estimated portions before eating:
- Wrap, cut in half (chicken, veg, tortilla): about 300 kcal, 200 g
- Sushi, 10 pieces (rolls with chicken, avocado, and veg): about 400 kcal, 300 g
- Side salad with a little dressing: about 60 kcal, 80 g
- Fruit bowl (watermelon, orange, cantaloupe, blueberries): about 60 kcal, 150 g
- Latte, about 250 ml of milk: about 120 kcal, 250 g, which I treat as a beverage and leave out of the food mass

Leftovers in the second photo:
- The sushi plate is clean, so all of it was eaten.
- The wrap plate has only sauce smears, so the wrap was eaten.
- The salad bowl is clear, with a plastic wrap remnant, so the salad was eaten.
- The fruit bowl has some orange juice residue, so the fruit was eaten.
- The soy sauce cup still has some left, and the wasabi was mostly used.
- The latte mug has a small residue, so it was mostly drunk.

The food eaten adds up to about 300 + 400 + 60 + 60 = 820 kcal. Including the latte brings it to about 940 kcal. The latte is a drink, so I count it in the energy but not in the food mass.

Food mass: 200 + 300 + 80 + 150 = 730 g, which I round down to about 720 g.
